# Test data

Workbooks saved by other applications, read by the reader tests of every implementation.

| File | Origin |
| --- | --- |
| `reader/excel.xlsx` | Written by Hypaxel (two tables, grouped, hidden and collapsed rows, row heights, column widths, a hidden column), then opened and saved by Microsoft Excel for Mac. Author names and add-in references were removed from the package afterwards. |
| `reader/libreoffice.xlsx` | The same Hypaxel workbook, converted to XLSX by LibreOffice Calc 25.2 (headless). LibreOffice drops the table styles and stores a height on every row. |
